requirement_ledger.external_intake_is_visibly_identifiable: pass: right-side flanged weather hood and louvers
requirement_ledger.air_path_is_continuous_and_directional: pass: hood -> filter -> meter -> diaphragm pump -> check valve -> manifold -> ring / vent
requirement_ledger.air_hardware_has_realistic_serviceable_f: pass: cartridge caps, seals, meter tube and float, diaphragm cover, fittings and fasteners
requirement_ledger.gas_sampling_branches_are_visible: pass: CH4, CO and O2 branch leads
requirement_ledger.low_voltage_demonstrator_scope: pass: visual only, no real hazardous gas operation implied

selected_defect: V06 showed a nominal intake path but did not visually explain how outside air entered or which physical components conditioned and moved the sample.
source_repair: Add a right-side weather hood, grille, louvers and flange inside the fixed one-metre envelope.
Replace the generic intake reading with an inline clear cartridge filter, vertical flow meter, 12 V diaphragm pump, check valve and explicit flexible hoses.
Add named sample branches from the manifold to the CH4, CO and O2 sampling positions.
limitation: The model represents a safe, generic low-voltage teaching demonstrator. Final filter pore size, pump flow rate, tubing material and vent routing must be selected against the actual sensor modules and laboratory safety plan.
